name: Bolster Mental Fortitude
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a small gold or silver circlet worth at least 5 gp)/DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 min./level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

The creature touched gains a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws against all mind-affecting spells and effects.
